It may not have been added to the container yet.{{#if: {{NAMESPACE}}||[[Category:Pages with empty semantic mediawiki query results]]}}}} == Description == List all [[container]]s that give the specified [[item]] in an unordered list. Semantically, queries for the [[Property:Contains item]] property. If the list is longer than 10, 60, or 80 items, the list will be split into two, three, or four columns respectively. Format using {{tl|Contained in/result format}}. Displays a suffix next to items depending on the [[Property: Has contained item quantity]], [[Property: Has contained item chance]], and [[Property:Has availability]]. {| class = "wikitable" !
